deleteCategory.title: Delete category?
deleteCategory.description: The "{{categoryName}}" category and its rules will be removed. Every document in it moves to Uncategorized, and no document is deleted.

deleteGroup.title: Delete group?
deleteGroup.description_one: The "{{groupName}}" group will be removed. 1 member will lose the permissions tied to this group, and the linked categories will be updated.
deleteGroup.description_other: The "{{groupName}}" group will be removed. {{count}} members will lose the permissions tied to this group, and the linked categories will be updated.

moveToTrash.title: Move to trash?
moveToTrash.description_one: This document will be moved to the trash. You can restore it during the retention period; after that it will be deactivated.
moveToTrash.description_other: {{count}} documents will be moved to the trash. You can restore them during the retention period; after that they will be deactivated.

rejectApproval.title: Decline the request?
rejectApproval.description: {{name}} will not have access to the company. This cannot be undone automatically: a new invitation will have to be sent.

removeFromGroup.title: Remove member from the group?
removeFromGroup.description: {{memberName}} will lose access to the categories granted to the {{groupName}} group. This can be undone by dragging the member back.

removeGroupFromCategory.title: Remove the group's access?
removeGroupFromCategory.description: Every member of the {{groupName}} group will lose access to the {{categoryName}} category.

removeMember.title: Remove member from the company?
removeMember.description: {{name}} will lose all access to documents and groups immediately. This is irreversible without a new invitation.

revokeSignatureRequest.title: Revoke the request?
revokeSignatureRequest.description: The signature invitation for {{signerName}} will be cancelled and the link will stop working.

suspendMember.title: Suspend access?
suspendMember.description: {{name}} will not be able to access documents until an administrator restores the access.
